name: Establish a container plant
short_description: Select a suitable container and growing medium and keep one plant stable for eight weeks.
self_assessment: I can establish one container plant for eight weeks without help under stated light conditions.
description: Select a suitable container and growing medium and keep one plant stable for eight weeks. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Maintain an edible or ornamental container plant
